name: Calimala

categories.label: Victory points on the scoring track (15 scoring phases)
categories.labelVi: Điểm thắng trên track (sau 15 lượt chấm điểm)
categories.hint: Include the 50 VP tile if you passed 50. Each phase: most cubes in the scored category gets 3 VP, second 2, third 1.

categories.label: Final scoring: your secret scoring card
categories.labelVi: Chấm điểm cuối: thẻ chấm điểm bí mật của bạn
categories.hint: Rank everyone on the category shown on your card: most cubes 5 VP, second 3, third 1 (0 if no cubes). Tie order: seats + artworks in the city council, then seats, then first to gain them.

categories.label: Final scoring: face-up scoring card (3-4 players)
categories.labelVi: Chấm điểm cuối: thẻ chấm điểm ngửa (3-4 người)
categories.hint: Same 5/3/1 ranking on the face-up card next to the board. Only used with 3 or 4 players.

categories.label: Seats + contributed artworks in the city council (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Ghế + tác phẩm ở hội đồng thành phố (phá hòa)
categories.hint: Only used to break ties on final points.

tiebreakers.description: Tied players: most seats and contributed artworks in the city council wins.

endCondition.description: Ends when all action discs are placed on the city grid, or after all 15 scoring tiles have been triggered (finish the current player round); then final scoring cards are resolved.

notes: family: area-majority. Final scoring: each player scores their own secret card; with 3 or 4 players the face-up card is also scored for everyone. Each card ranks all players on the stated cube count (Palazzo Vecchio counts seats plus contributed artwork cubes). In-phase ties use seats and artworks tiebreak; if all tiebreaks are equal the points are split and rounded down. Enter the per-card VP after resolving ranks and ties. The 2nd edition and the 2-player variant rulebooks were not checked.

sources.title: Calimala Rulebook (EN, 2017)
